L10: Our Approach
L11: ## Deploying reliable AI-powered Industrial robotics solution to solve today’s labor challenges
L12: 
L13: AI-powered Robotics is considered a solution to today’s industry labor challenges. However, current AI approaches struggle with real-world complexity and fail to meet the reliability standards (99+% success rate) required for industrial applications.
L14: Contoro’s robots collect real-world data while providing reliable operations from day 1 for industrial customers through a human-in-the-loop (HITL) approach. Our advanced, patented human-robot interface allows our operators to remotely control robots located at customer’s sites for tasks where AI fails (edge cases). The HITL approach creates a continuous AI-learning loop and results in an AI model that reliably works within the customer environment with an accelerated AI-evolution timeline.
